Question_EN: What should I check before buying a home in India?
Question_Hinglish: Ghar kharidne se pehle kya-kya dekhna chahiye?
Answer_Hinglish: Budget (EMI take-home income ka lagbhag 40% tak), location aur connectivity, builder ka track record, RERA registration, clear title, approvals/OC, carpet area aur total cost (stamp duty, GST, maintenance) check karein. Site visit zaroor karein aur documents kisi lawyer se verify karwayein.
Answer_EN: Check budget (EMI within ~40% of take-home income), location and connectivity, builder's track record, RERA registration, clear title, approvals/Occupancy Certificate, usable carpet area, and all-inclusive costs (stamp duty, GST, maintenance). Always conduct a physical site visit and get documents verified by an independent lawyer.
Tags: buying, home purchase, property buying

Question_EN: Flat or independent house, which is better?
Question_Hinglish: Flat lein ya independent house/villa?
Answer_Hinglish: Flat me security, amenities aur kam maintenance effort milta hai, lekin land ka hissa chhota hota hai. Independent house me privacy aur zyada land value milti hai, par maintenance aur security aapki zimmedari hoti hai. Budget, city aur lifestyle dekh kar choose karein.
Answer_EN: Flats offer security, amenities, and lower maintenance burden, but have a smaller undivided share of land. Independent houses provide privacy, freedom, and higher land value, but maintenance and security are your responsibility. Choose based on your budget, city, and lifestyle.

Question_EN: Ready-to-move or under-construction property?
Question_Hinglish: Ready-to-move lein ya under-construction?
Answer_Hinglish: Ready-to-move me ghar dekh kar lete hain, possession turant milta hai aur OC ke saath GST nahi lagta. Under-construction me price kam aur payment plan flexible ho sakta hai, par delay ka risk rehta hai. RERA-registered aur trusted builder ho to under-construction bhi theek hai.
Answer_EN: Ready-to-move properties allow physical inspection, offer immediate possession, and attract 0% GST with an Occupancy Certificate (OC). Under-construction homes are often lower priced with flexible payment plans, but carry possession delay risk. If buying under-construction, ensure the builder is RERA-registered and reputable.

Answer_EN: Thumb rule: Total monthly EMIs should not exceed 40% of net monthly income, and property price should remain within 3-5 times your annual income. Keep emergency funds and existing loans separate. You can check your comfortable budget using INDSTATE's EMI Calculator.

Question_Hinglish: Carpet area, built-up area aur super built-up area me kya farak hai?

Answer_EN: Carpet area is the actual usable net floor area enclosed within inner walls. Built-up area includes wall thickness and balcony. Super built-up area includes common areas like elevators, staircases, and lobby. Under RERA regulations, developers must quote prices strictly on carpet area.

Question_EN: What is the difference between freehold and leasehold property?
Question_Hinglish: Freehold aur leasehold property me kya farak hai?
Answer_Hinglish: Freehold me aap land aur building ke poore owner hote hain. Leasehold me land ek fixed period (jaise 30-99 saal) ke liye lease par hoti hai aur transfer/renewal ke liye authority ki permission ya charges lag sakte hain. Loan aur resale me freehold aasan rehta hai.
Answer_EN: In freehold property, you own both the land and the building outright. In leasehold property, the land is leased for a fixed period (such as 30-99 years), and transfer or renewal requires authority permission and fees. Freehold properties are easier to finance and resell.

Question_EN: Fixed or floating interest rate, which is better?
Question_Hinglish: Fixed ya floating interest rate, kaun sa better hai?
Answer_Hinglish: Floating rate market/repo rate ke saath change hota hai, aam taur par shuruaat me kam hota hai aur individuals ke liye prepayment penalty nahi hoti. Fixed rate me EMI predictable rehti hai par rate zyada ho sakta hai aur kai banks fixed period ke baad floating me convert karte hain. Long tenure ke liye zyada log floating choose karte hain.
Answer_EN: Floating rates change in tandem with market/repo rates, are typically lower initially, and carry zero prepayment penalty for individual borrowers. Fixed rates offer predictable EMIs but carry higher initial rates, and often revert to floating after a fixed tenure. Floating is favored for long-term home loans.

Question_EN: How does the RBI repo rate affect my EMI?
Question_Hinglish: Repo rate badhne ya girne se meri EMI par kya asar padta hai?
Answer_Hinglish: Zyadatar floating home loans repo-linked (EBLR) hote hain. Repo rate badhne par interest rate badhta hai, jisse EMI ya loan tenure badh jata hai; girne par ulta hota hai. Rate change ke baad bank se poochein ki EMI badhi hai ya tenure.
Answer_EN: Most retail floating home loans are linked to the RBI repo rate via EBLR. When repo rate rises, interest rate increases, which banks typically adjust by extending tenure or raising EMI; when repo rate drops, interest burden reduces. Always check with your bank whether EMI or tenure was modified.

Keywords: affect, does, emi, interest rate, rate, rbi, repo, repo rate, tenure

Question_EN: What loan tenure should I choose?
Question_Hinglish: Loan ka tenure kitna rakhna chahiye?
Answer_Hinglish: Lamba tenure me EMI kam hoti hai par total interest zyada dena padta hai. Chhota tenure me EMI zyada par interest bachta hai. Comfortable EMI rakhein aur jab bonus/extra paisa aaye to part-prepayment karke tenure kam karte jayein.
Answer_EN: A longer loan tenure lowers your monthly EMI but increases the cumulative interest paid. A shorter tenure carries higher EMIs but saves substantial interest. Pick a comfortable EMI and use annual bonuses or surpluses to make regular part-prepayments to cut tenure.

Keywords: choose, loan, prepayment, rk, tenure

Question_EN: What is the home loan processing fee?

Question_EN: What is a pre-approved home loan?
Question_Hinglish: Pre-approved home loan kya hota hai?
Answer_Hinglish: Isme bank aapki income aur credit profile ke basis par pehle se ek maximum loan limit approve kar deta hai, property final hone se pehle. Isse budget clear hota hai aur negotiation aasan hota hai, par final sanction property ke legal verification par depend karta hai.
Answer_EN: A pre-approved home loan is an in-principle approval based on your income, credit history, and financial eligibility before you finalize a property. It clarifies your budget and strengthens price negotiations, though final sanction depends on legal and technical property clearance.
Tags: bank-advisory, banking, emi, finance, home loan

Question_EN: What is LTV (loan-to-value) in home loans?
Question_Hinglish: LTV ratio kya hota hai?
Answer_Hinglish: LTV = loan amount / property value. RBI norms ke hisab se aam taur par 30 lakh tak ke loan par 90%, 30-75 lakh par 80%, aur 75 lakh se upar par 75% tak LTV allowed hota hai. Baaki hissa aapko down payment ke roop me dena hota hai.
Answer_EN: Loan-to-Value (LTV) is the ratio of loan amount to property valuation. Under RBI guidelines: Up to ₹30 Lakh loan allows up to 90% LTV, ₹30L to ₹75L allows up to 80% LTV, and loans above ₹75 Lakh allow up to 75% LTV. The remaining percentage represents the buyer's down payment.
Tags: bank-advisory, banking, emi, finance, home loan
Keywords: down payment, home, loan, loans, ltv, value

Question_EN: Are there prepayment charges on home loans?
Question_Hinglish: Home loan prepay karne par penalty lagti hai?
Answer_Hinglish: RBI ke rules ke mutabik individuals ke floating-rate home loans par prepayment/foreclosure charges nahi lagte. Fixed-rate loans par kuch banks charges lagate hain, isliye loan agreement check karein.
Answer_EN: Under RBI regulations, banks and HFCs are prohibited from charging prepayment or foreclosure penalties on floating-rate home loans sanctioned to individual borrowers. Fixed-rate loans may attract prepayment penalties depending on the loan contract terms.
Tags: bank-advisory, banking, emi, finance, home loan
Keywords: charges, home, loans, prepayment

Question_EN: Should I make part-prepayment on my home loan?
Question_Hinglish: Part-prepayment karna faydemand hai?

Answer_EN: Yes, part-prepayment directly reduces the outstanding principal balance, leading to massive interest savings, particularly in the initial years of the loan. You can choose to reduce your EMI or shorten the loan tenure. Maintain your emergency fund first, then prepay with surplus funds.
Tags: bank-advisory, banking, emi, finance, home loan
Keywords: home, loan, make, part, prepayment, tenure

Question_EN: When should I do a home loan balance transfer?
Question_Hinglish: Home loan balance transfer kab karna chahiye?
Answer_Hinglish: Jab naye bank ka rate current rate se lagbhag 0.5-1% ya usse zyada kam ho aur remaining tenure kaafi lamba ho, tab fayda hota hai. Processing fee, legal charges aur foreclosure costs ka hisaab lagakar hi decide karein.
Answer_EN: A balance transfer makes financial sense when another lender offers an interest rate that is 0.50% to 1.00% lower and your remaining tenure is sufficiently long. Factor in processing fees, legal charges, and foreclosure costs before deciding.

Question_EN: What are the income tax benefits on a home loan?

Answer_EN: Under the old tax regime, you can claim deductions on principal repayment under Section 80C (with applicable limits) and home loan interest on self-occupied property under Section 24(b). Question_EN: What is pre-EMI in an under-construction property loan?
Question_Hinglish: Pre-EMI kya hota hai?
Answer_Hinglish: Under-construction property me bank builder ko stages me paisa deta hai, aur jitna disbursed hota hai sirf uske interest ka bhugtan (Pre-EMI) karna hota hai. Possession ke baad full EMI (principal + interest) shuru hoti hai. Isliye is dauran kiraya + Pre-EMI dono ka budget rakhein.
Answer_EN: For under-construction homes, banks disburse loan funds in stages linked to construction milestones. Pre-EMI is the interest charged only on the disbursed amount until full completion. Regular full EMI (principal + interest) commences only upon possession. Budget for both rent and Pre-EMI during construction.

Question_EN: Is a subvention or 80:20 scheme safe?
Question_Hinglish: Subvention scheme ya 80:20 plan safe hota hai?

Answer_EN: In subvention or 80:20 schemes, the developer agrees to service the interest/EMI for a specific duration. Question_EN: Is home loan insurance necessary?

Question_EN: How is home loan EMI calculated?
Question_Hinglish: EMI kaise calculate hoti hai?
Answer_Hinglish: EMI = P x R x (1+R)^N / ((1+R)^N - 1), jahan P loan amount, R monthly interest rate (annual/12/100) aur N months me tenure hai. Aap INDSTATE ke EMI Calculator me amount, rate aur tenure daal kar turant EMI dekh sakte hain.
Answer_EN: EMI is calculated as: EMI = P × R × (1+R)^N / ((1+R)^N - 1), where P is principal loan amount, R is monthly interest rate, and N is tenure in months. You can use INDSTATE's online EMI Calculator to instantly simulate EMIs, interest breakdowns, and amortization schedules.

Question_EN: What is the difference between a home loan and a loan against property?

Question_EN: Who can be a co-applicant for a home loan?

Question_EN: Can I get a loan for a plot or for self-construction?

Question_EN: What is RERA?

Answer_EN: RERA (Real Estate Regulation and Development Act, 2016) is a central law enacted to protect homebuyers and ensure transparency in real estate transactions. Question_EN: Why is RERA registration important?

Answer_EN: Registered projects must disclose sanctioned layout plans, completion milestones, carpet areas, approvals, and promoter credentials. The builder is legally bound by committed timelines and rules. Unregistered projects lack RERA protection and statutory dispute resolution mechanisms, posing severe financial risk.

Question_EN: How do I verify a RERA number?

Question_EN: Which projects are exempt from RERA?

Question_EN: What if the builder delays possession under RERA?
Question_Hinglish: Builder possession me delay kare to RERA me kya option hai?
Answer_Hinglish: Buyer ke paas do options aam taur par hote hain: project me rehkar delay ki taareekh tak interest lena, ya agreement se bahar nikal kar paisa interest ke saath refund lena. Interest rate state RERA rules ke hisab se tay hota hai. Formal complaint state RERA authority me file hoti hai.
Answer_EN: Homebuyers have two primary legal options under RERA: 1) Remain in the project and claim monthly interest for every month of delay until handover, or 2) Exit the project and demand a full refund of paid amounts along with prescribed interest. Question_EN: How much advance can a builder take before agreement?

Answer_EN: Under Section 13 of RERA, a promoter cannot demand or accept more than 10% of the total property cost as an advance payment or application fee prior to entering into a registered written agreement for sale. Demanding higher sums is a regulatory violation that can be reported to RERA.

Question_EN: What is the RERA 70% escrow account rule?

Answer_EN: Developers are legally mandated to deposit 70% of all funds collected from homebuyers into a dedicated project escrow bank account. Question_EN: How do I file a complaint with RERA?

Question_EN: What is the RERA 5-year structural defect liability?

Question_EN: What is an Agreement for Sale?
Question_Hinglish: Agreement for Sale kya hota hai?

Answer_EN: An Agreement for Sale is a legally binding contract between buyer and developer detailing the total price, payment schedule, possession date, carpet area specifications, and default penalties. Under RERA, it must conform to the statutory model agreement and be duly registered.

Question_EN: What is the difference between an agreement to sell and a sale deed?
Question_Hinglish: Agreement to sell aur Sale Deed me kya farak hai?

Answer_EN: An Agreement to Sell is a contractual promise outlining the terms under which property will be transferred in the future, whereas a Sale Deed is the final executed document that actually conveys legal title and ownership to the buyer. Ownership legally transfers only upon registration of the Sale Deed.

Question_EN: What is a title deed and how do I check it?

Answer_EN: A title deed establishes legal ownership over immovable property. The seller must possess an unbroken chain of title documents tracing historical ownership (typically for 30 years). Always engage a property advocate to conduct a formal search across Sub-Registrar records.

Question_EN: What is an Encumbrance Certificate (EC)?
Question_Hinglish: Encumbrance Certificate (EC) kya hota hai?

Answer_EN: An Encumbrance Certificate (EC) certifies whether a property is free from registered mortgages, legal charges, or financial encumbrances for a specified timeframe. Question_EN: What is an Occupancy Certificate (OC)?
Question_Hinglish: Occupancy Certificate (OC) kya hota hai?

Answer_EN: An Occupancy Certificate (OC) is issued by the local municipal body certifying that the building was constructed in compliance with approved plans and safety norms, and is fit for habitation. Question_EN: What is a Completion Certificate (CC)?
Question_Hinglish: Completion Certificate kya hota hai?

Answer_EN: A Completion Certificate (CC) certifies that construction of the building has been completed in adherence to sanctioned building bye-laws and zoning norms. In several states, both CC and OC are required, so verify both with the developer before taking handover.
Tags: lawyer-verification, legal, legal documents, property law, rera
Keywords: certificate, completion, completion certificate

Question_EN: What is mutation of property?
Question_Hinglish: Property mutation (dakhil-kharij / name transfer) kya hota hai?

Answer_EN: Property mutation (Dakhil-Kharij / Khata transfer) records the transfer of title in local municipal and revenue registers to ensure property tax bills and official records are issued in the new owner's name. Question_EN: What is A Khata and B Khata in Karnataka?

Question_EN: What is a 7/12 extract in Maharashtra?

Answer_EN: In Maharashtra, the 7/12 extract (Satbara Utara) is a revenue land record reflecting ownership, survey number, land classification, and encumbrances. Inspecting the 7/12 extract and Property Card is critical before purchasing land or plots to verify clean legal title.

Question_EN: Which NOCs are required when buying a property?

Answer_EN: Essential NOCs include the Society/Builder NOC confirming zero unpaid dues, Bank NOC/No Objection Letter with closure certificate (if the property was mortgaged), and utility clearances. In resale transactions, insist on receiving all original NOCs prior to registration.

Question_EN: Is buying property through Power of Attorney safe?
Question_Hinglish: Power of Attorney (POA) se property kharidna safe hai?
Answer_Hinglish: Supreme Court ne kaha hai ki sirf GPA/agreement se property ki ownership transfer nahi hoti; sale deed ka registration zaroori hai. POA par kharidne me fraud aur legal dispute ka risk zyada hota hai, isliye registered sale deed hi pakka rasta hai.
Answer_EN: The Supreme Court of India has ruled that transfers effected via General Power of Attorney (GPA) or Agreement to Sell do not confer valid legal title; ownership transfers strictly through a registered Sale Deed. Purchasing via GPA carries severe risk of fraud and future title disputes.

Question_EN: How to buy a property that came by inheritance or will?
Question_Hinglish: Inherited ya will se mili property kharidne me kya dhyan rakhein?

Question_EN: What should I do if there is a property dispute?
Question_Hinglish: Property dispute ho jaye to kya karein?

Answer_EN: Maintain a meticulous record of all agreements, payment receipts, and communications, and consult a qualified property lawyer immediately. Approach RERA for builder default issues, Civil Courts for title/partition suits, or Consumer Forums for deficiency in service.

Question_EN: How do I get a title search or legal opinion done?
Question_Hinglish: Title search ya legal opinion kaise karwayein?
Answer_Hinglish: Property lawyer ko sale deed, previous ownership documents, EC aur tax receipts dein. Wo sub-registrar, revenue aur court records me search karke chain of title aur litigation check karte hain, aur ek written legal opinion dete hain. Ye kharcha buyer ke liye bahut kaam ka hota hai.
Answer_EN: Provide the Sale Deed, link parent documents, tax receipts, and Encumbrance Certificates to a property lawyer. The advocate conducts searches at the Sub-Registrar's office, revenue offices, and court registries to verify clear title and prepare a formal written Legal Search Report.
Tags: lawyer-verification, legal, legal documents, property law, rera
Keywords: done, get, legal, opinion, rk, search, title

Question_EN: What clauses should I check in the sale agreement?
Question_Hinglish: Sale agreement me kaun-kaun se clauses dekhne chahiye?
Answer_Hinglish: Possession date aur delay penalty, payment schedule, carpet area aur specifications, cancellation/refund terms, maintenance aur parking details, aur dispute resolution. One-sided ya vague clauses par lawyer se explanation lein aur unhe negotiate karein.
Answer_EN: Carefully inspect clauses detailing committed possession timeline, grace period, delay compensation rate, carpet area specifications, cancellation penalties, defect liability, undivided land share, and dispute resolution mechanisms. Avoid one-sided builder-buyer agreements.
Tags: lawyer-verification, legal, legal documents, property law, rera
Keywords: agreement, carpet area, check, clauses, rk, sale

Question_EN: Is registration of a sale deed compulsory?
Question_Hinglish: Sale deed ka registration compulsory hai?
Answer_Hinglish: Haan, Registration Act ke tahat immovable property ke sale ka registered document hona zaroori hai. Bina registration ke ownership legally transfer nahi hoti, aur aap property par apna hak court me prove nahi kar paate.
Answer_EN: Yes, under the Registration Act, 1908, registration of a Sale Deed for immovable property valued above ₹100 is legally compulsory. Unregistered documents cannot confer valid ownership title or be admitted as primary evidence of ownership in a court of law.
Tags: lawyer-verification, legal, legal documents, property law, rera
Keywords: compulsory, deed, registration, sale

Question_EN: How do I verify approved building plan and property tax?
Question_Hinglish: Approved layout/building plan aur property tax kaise check karein?
Answer_Hinglish: Local development authority ya municipal corporation se sanctioned plan aur approvals ki copy maangein aur unke record se match karein. Property tax receipts dekhein, kyunki unpaid tax ya mismatch area red flag ho sakta hai. Unauthorised construction par loan aur resale me problem aati hai.
Answer_EN: Request copies of the sanctioned building layout plan and commencement certificate from the developer and cross-check them with the local municipal planning authority. Verify municipal property tax receipts to confirm zero arrears and prevent purchasing unauthorized constructions.
Tags: lawyer-verification, legal, legal documents, property law, rera
Keywords: and, approved, building, plan, property, property tax, resale, tax, verify

Question_EN: How can I avoid property fraud?
Question_Hinglish: Property fraud se kaise bachein?
Answer_Hinglish: Sirf verified documents par bharosa karein: title deed, EC, approvals, OC, tax receipts aur RERA registration ko independently verify karein. Payment hamesha bank/traceable modes se karein aur kisi bhi dabav ya jaldbaazi me na aayein. Lawyer se due diligence zaroor karwayein.
Answer_EN: Protect yourself by relying solely on verified original documentation: title chain, EC, municipal approvals, OC, tax receipts, and RERA registration. Never pay in untraceable cash; transact only through formal banking channels, and engage an independent lawyer for title due diligence.
Tags: due diligence, fraud prevention, lawyer-verification, legal, verification
Keywords: avoid, fraud, property, registration, rera, title deed

Question_EN: How can I spot fake property documents?
Question_Hinglish: Fake documents kaise pehchanein?
Answer_Hinglish: Original documents dekhne par zor dein aur sub-registrar/revenue records se cross-check karwayein. Stamp paper, seal, signatures, survey numbers aur dates me mismatch red flag hain. Sirf photocopy ya scan par bharosa na karein.
Answer_EN: Demand to inspect original parent documents and cross-verify certified copies directly with the Sub-Registrar's records. Red flags include discrepancies in stamp paper serial numbers, mismatched seals, inconsistent signatures, conflicting survey numbers, or recent dates on older deeds.
Tags: due diligence, fraud prevention, lawyer-verification, legal, verification
Keywords: documents, fake, property, spot

Question_EN: How do I avoid the same property being sold to multiple buyers?
Question_Hinglish: Ek hi property multiple logon ko bech di jaye to kaise bachein?
Answer_Hinglish: Latest EC aur sub-registrar records se check karein ki property par kaunsi sales ya mortgages registered hain. Seller ka possession aur society/builder records se bhi confirm karein. Registered sale deed ke baad hi payment poori karein aur possession lein.
Answer_EN: Obtain the latest Encumbrance Certificate (EC) and verify the Sub-Registrar's Index-II records to confirm no recent sales, agreements, or mortgages exist on the property. Verify physical possession and society share certificates before paying the final sale consideration.
Tags: due diligence, fraud prevention, lawyer-verification, legal, verification
Keywords: avoid, being, buyers, multiple, property, same, sold

Question_EN: How do I verify the seller or owner?
Question_Hinglish: Seller ya owner ko kaise verify karein?
Answer_Hinglish: Seller ka ID proof (Aadhaar, PAN), title documents me naam match hona, property tax receipts aur EC dekhein. Agar seller POA holder hai to POA ki validity aur original owner se confirmation lein. Sab kuch documents me consistent hona chahiye.
Answer_EN: Verify government-issued photo ID proofs (Aadhaar, PAN) of the seller and ensure the name matches municipal and title records exactly. If the property is sold via Power of Attorney (POA), verify the POA's authenticity, validity, and confirm directly with the original principal owner.
Tags: due diligence, fraud prevention, lawyer-verification, legal, verification
Keywords: owner, property tax, seller, verify

Question_EN: What should I check before paying a token amount?
Question_Hinglish: Token amount dene se pehle kya check karein?
Answer_Hinglish: Seller ki ownership, basic documents, property par loan ya dispute na hona aur RERA status (under-construction me) verify karein. Token amount bank transfer se dein, written receipt lein aur likhwayein ki token kis condition me refundable hai.
Answer_EN: Verify seller ownership, parent title deeds, absence of pending mortgages or litigation, and active RERA registration (for under-construction projects). Always pay token advances via formal bank transfer, obtain a written receipt, and specify explicit refund conditions.
Tags: due diligence, fraud prevention, verification
Keywords: amount, before, check, paying, rera, token

Question_EN: Is paying in cash for property safe?
Question_Hinglish: Property ke liye cash payment safe hai?
Answer_Hinglish: Cash payment risky aur aksar kanoon ke against hota hai. Income Tax rules bade cash transactions par restrictions lagate hain aur cash payment ka proof kamzor hota hai. Hamesha bank transfer/cheque/DD se payment karein aur receipts rakhein.
Answer_EN: Cash payments for property are unsafe and strictly restricted under Section 269SS/269T of the Income Tax Act. Cash leaves negligible legal proof of consideration in disputes. Always transact using cheques, demand drafts, or electronic bank transfers with formal receipts.
Tags: due diligence, fraud prevention, lawyer-verification, legal, verification
Keywords: cash, paying, property, safe

Question_EN: What if the seller asks for a black money or cash component?
Question_Hinglish: Seller cash ya black money maange to kya karein?
Answer_Hinglish: Ye illegal hai aur buyer ke liye bhi tax aur legal risk badhata hai. Full value par registration aur banking channel se payment hi safe rasta hai. Aisi demand par deal reconsider karein ya lawyer se salah lein.
Answer_EN: Demanding cash or an undeclared component is illegal, creating severe income tax penalties and legal exposure for both parties. Registering at full transacted value via banking channels is the only legally secure route. Reconsider the deal or seek legal counsel if pressured.
Tags: due diligence, fraud prevention, lawyer-verification, legal, verification
Keywords: asks, black, cash, component, money, registration, seller

Question_EN: How do I identify a fake broker or agent?
Question_Hinglish: Fake broker ya agent kaise pehchanein?
Answer_Hinglish: Agent ka RERA registration number state RERA website par verify karein, uska office address aur reviews check karein, aur advance sirf owner/builder ko seedha dein, agent ke personal account me nahi. INDSTATE ke Verified Agents section me registered agents dekh sakte hain.
Answer_EN: Verify the agent's RERA registration certificate on your state RERA portal, inspect their registered office address, and check client testimonials. Never transfer advance booking amounts or token money to an agent's personal account; pay directly to the builder/owner.

Question_EN: How do I know if an online listing is fake?
Question_Hinglish: Online listing fake to nahi, ye kaise pata karein?
Answer_Hinglish: Photos ka reverse image search karein, price market se bahut kam ho to alert rahein, aur bina site visit ke advance na dein. Owner ya agent ko video call par ghar dikhane ko kahein. Suspicious listing ko platform par report karein.
Answer_EN: Perform reverse image searches on listing photos, remain cautious of prices unrealistically below market benchmarks, and never transfer advance funds before a physical site visit. Request a live video call walkthrough and report fraudulent listings to the platform.

Question_EN: What if I paid an advance and I'm not getting a refund?
Question_Hinglish: Advance de diya aur refund nahi mil raha to kya karein?
Answer_Hinglish: Written agreement/receipt ke basis par legal notice bhejein. Builder ke case me RERA authority me complaint file karein, aur individual seller ke case me consumer/civil remedy ho sakta hai. Payment proof, chats aur emails safe rakhein.
Answer_EN: Issue a formal legal notice based on your written payment receipt and booking contract. If the issue is with a developer, lodge an immediate complaint on the state RERA portal; for individual sellers, file for recovery through consumer or civil court remedies.

Question_EN: What is the risk if a builder goes bankrupt?
Question_Hinglish: Builder bankrupt ho jaye to buyer ka kya hoga?
Answer_Hinglish: Isse project stall ya delay ho sakta hai. RERA registered project me escrow account aur regulatory oversight se protection milti hai, par risk fir bhi rehta hai. Builder ki financial strength, past delivery record aur project ke approvals dekh kar hi invest karein.
Answer_EN: Developer insolvency can stall construction and freeze project accounts. While RERA registration and statutory escrow provisions offer significant safeguards, insolvency proceedings (NCLT) cause prolonged delays. Always evaluate developer financial standing and delivery track record beforehand.
Tags: due diligence, fraud prevention, verification

Question_EN: How do I check society dues and NOC before buying resale?
Question_Hinglish: Resale me society dues aur NOC kaise check karein?

Answer_EN: Request a formal No Dues Certificate and Transfer NOC directly from the housing society office, confirming zero outstanding maintenance dues, sinking fund arrears, or pending litigation. Unpaid dues can legally pass on to the new purchaser.

Question_EN: Is buying a bank auction property safe?
Question_Hinglish: Bank auction (SARFAESI) property kharidna safe hai?
Answer_Hinglish: Auction properties aksar market se sasti hoti hain par as-is-where-is basis par bikti hain, aur kai me possession ya legal dispute ho sakte hain. Bank ki auction notice, title, dues aur physical possession ki details verify karein aur lawyer se opinion lein.
Answer_EN: Bank auction properties under the SARFAESI Act are often priced attractively, but are sold strictly on an 'as-is-where-is' basis. Investigate whether the bank has physical vacant possession, verify unpaid municipal/utility taxes, and seek legal counsel before bidding.

Question_EN: How do I check whether land is converted to non-agricultural (NA)?
Question_Hinglish: Land NA (non-agricultural) converted hai ya nahi, kaise check karein?
Answer_Hinglish: Revenue records (jaise 7/12, khasra/khatauni) aur local authority se NA order ya land-use certificate dekhein. Bina NA conversion ke residential construction ya loan me dikkat aa sakti hai. State-wise process alag hota hai.
Answer_EN: Inspect land revenue records (such as 7/12 extract, Khasra/Khatauni) and demand the official Non-Agricultural (NA) conversion order from the District Collector or local planning authority. Constructing on unconverted agricultural land is illegal and uninsurable.

Question_EN: How can I check if a property has any court case?
Question_Hinglish: Property par koi court case hai ya nahi, ye kaise check karein?
Answer_Hinglish: Lawyer ke through local courts aur revenue courts ke records me search karwayein aur eCourts portal par naam/property details se check karein. Seller se written declaration lein ki property par koi litigation nahi hai.
Answer_EN: Engage a property advocate to conduct court searches across local civil courts, revenue tribunals, and the official eCourts portal using survey numbers and party names. Obtain a sworn non-litigation declaration and indemnity bond from the seller.

Question_EN: Can a property be under government acquisition or in a restricted zone?
Question_Hinglish: Kya property government acquisition ya green belt me ho sakti hai?

Answer_EN: Certain lands fall within designated green belts, Coastal Regulation Zones (CRZ), flood plains, defense buffers, or notified government acquisition tracks. Review master development plans, zoning maps, and verify with local development authorities before purchasing.

Question_Hinglish: Documents me seller ke naam ki spelling alag ho to?

Question_EN: What are the top red flags in a property deal?
Question_Hinglish: Property deal me top red flags kya hote hain?

Answer_EN: Prominent red flags include prices significantly below market valuation, high-pressure urgency tactics, cash-only demands, refusal to show original deeds, absence of RERA number or approvals, frequent changes of intermediaries, and resisting independent legal verification.

Question_EN: What can I do if possession is delayed?
Question_Hinglish: Possession delay ho jaye to kya karein?
Answer_Hinglish: Agreement me possession date aur delay penalty check karein. RERA-registered project me aap RERA authority me complaint karke interest ya refund maang sakte hain. Builder ko written notice bhejein aur saare payment proofs aur communication safe rakhein.
Answer_EN: Review the agreed possession date and default penalty clauses in your Agreement for Sale. For RERA-registered projects, file a complaint before the state RERA authority to claim prescribed monthly interest for delays or exit with full refund plus interest.
Tags: builder issues, lawyer-verification, legal, possession delay, under-construction
Keywords: delayed, possession, rera, rk

Question_EN: Construction-linked vs time-linked payment plan, which is better?
Question_Hinglish: Construction-linked aur time-linked payment plan me kaun sa better hai?
Answer_Hinglish: Construction-linked plan me payment construction stages ke saath hoti hai, isliye risk kam hota hai. Time-linked plan me tay date par payment deni hoti hai chahe construction kitni bhi hui ho. Aam taur par construction-linked buyer ke liye safer hota hai.
Answer_EN: In a construction-linked plan (CLP), installments are payable only after certified completion of specific construction milestones, keeping developer accountability high. Time-linked plans demand payments on fixed dates regardless of progress. CLP is significantly safer for homebuyers.
Tags: builder issues, possession delay, under-construction
Keywords: better, construction, linked, payment, plan, time

Question_EN: What if the builder changes specifications or reduces area?
Question_Hinglish: Builder specs badal de ya area kam nikle to?
Answer_Hinglish: Agreement me likhi specs aur RERA registration ke sanctioned plans se compare karein. Carpet area kam ho to proportionate refund ya adjustment claim kiya ja sakta hai, aur unauthorised changes par RERA me complaint ho sakti hai. Photos aur written communication ka record rakhein.
Answer_EN: Compare delivered specifications with the sanctioned plans and specifications attached to the registered agreement. Under RERA, developers cannot make unauthorized alterations to sanctioned plans without consent; carpet area reductions require a proportionate refund.
Tags: builder issues, lawyer-verification, legal, possession delay, under-construction
Keywords: area, builder, carpet area, changes, reduces, registration, rera, specifications

Question_EN: Can I cancel my booking and get a refund?
Question_Hinglish: Booking cancel karke refund mil sakta hai?
Answer_Hinglish: Refund agreement ki cancellation clause par depend karta hai. Builder ki galti (delay/violation) ho to RERA me full refund interest ke saath maang sakte hain. Apni taraf se cancel karne par kuch amount forfeit ho sakta hai, isliye one-sided clauses par pehle hi lawyer se check karwayein.
Answer_EN: Refund entitlement depends on the contractual cancellation clauses. If cancellation arises due to developer breach, default, or missed deadlines, RERA entitles you to a full refund with interest. Voluntary cancellation may incur forfeiture of token amounts as per agreed terms.
Tags: builder issues, lawyer-verification, legal, possession delay, under-construction
Keywords: and, booking, cancel, get, refund, rera, rk

Question_EN: What should I check during possession (snagging)?
Question_Hinglish: Possession ke waqt kya-kya check karein?
Answer_Hinglish: Walls, flooring, doors-windows, plumbing, electrical points, waterproofing, lift aur common areas ka detailed inspection karein aur defects ki written list (snag list) builder ko dein. Approved plan ke mutabik area, OC aur amenities bhi confirm karein, aur tabhi possession accept karein.
Answer_EN: Inspect plastering, flooring, doors, windows, plumbing fixtures, electrical switches, waterproofing, elevator operations, and common amenities. Prepare a detailed written Snag List and submit it to the developer for rectification before accepting final key handover.
Tags: builder issues, possession delay, under-construction
Keywords: check, during, possession, snagging

Question_EN: What if the carpet area received is less than promised?
Question_Hinglish: Carpet area promised se kam mile to?
Answer_Hinglish: RERA ke tahat buyer ko carpet area ke hisab se price dena hota hai, isliye area kam mile to proportionate refund ya adjustment maang sakte hain. Pehle agreement, sanctioned plan aur actual measurement se compare karein aur builder ko written complaint dein.
Answer_EN: Under RERA, property prices must be billed strictly on actual usable carpet area. If the handed-over carpet area is less than promised, you are entitled to a proportionate price refund. Verify measurements using an independent architect and lodge a written claim.

Keywords: area, carpet, carpet area, less, promised, received, rera, than

Question_EN: How can I exit or cancel an agreement with the builder?
Question_Hinglish: Builder ke saath agreement se bahar kaise nikalein?
Answer_Hinglish: Agreement ke exit/termination clauses dekhein aur builder ko written notice dein. RERA me delay ya default ki wajah se exit ka refund maang sakte hain. Voluntary exit me kuch deduction lag sakta hai, isliye pehle legal advice lein.
Answer_EN: Review the exit and termination provisions in your registered Agreement for Sale and serve a formal written notice on the developer. In cases of developer default or excessive project delay, seek statutory refund under RERA. Voluntary exits may involve deduction of nominal administrative charges.
Tags: builder issues, lawyer-verification, legal, possession delay, under-construction
Keywords: agreement, builder, cancel, exit, rera, with

Question_EN: What is the RERA extension or force majeure clause?
Question_Hinglish: RERA me force majeure ya extension ka matlab kya hota hai?
Answer_Hinglish: Kuch unpredictable events (jaise natural disaster, pandemic, government orders) me RERA authority project ki deadline extend kar sakti hai. Builder har delay ke liye ise use nahi kar sakta, aur extension ki details RERA website par dikhni chahiye.
Answer_EN: Force majeure covers extraordinary, unforeseeable events beyond developer control (such as natural calamities, epidemics, or government-mandated construction bans). RERA authorities evaluate force majeure claims independently; developers cannot cite routine business delays as force majeure.
Tags: builder issues, lawyer-verification, legal, possession delay, under-construction
Keywords: clause, extension, force, majeure, rera

Question_EN: How do I know if a builder is trustworthy?
Question_Hinglish: Builder trustworthy hai ya nahi kaise pata karein?
Answer_Hinglish: Builder ke pichle delivered projects visit karein, RERA me complaints aur delays ka record check karein, current buyers/resident associations se baat karein, aur financial/legal news bhi search karein. Sirf brochures aur ads par bharosa na karein.
Answer_EN: Inspect earlier completed projects delivered by the builder, review RERA complaint history and delay records, interact with existing resident welfare associations, and check financial credit ratings. Never rely solely on promotional brochures or advertisements.
Tags: builder issues, possession delay, under-construction
Keywords: builder, know, rera, trustworthy

Question_EN: Which approvals should an under-construction project have?
Question_Hinglish: Under-construction project ke paas kaun-kaun se approvals hone chahiye?
Answer_Hinglish: Land title, approved building/layout plan, commencement certificate, RERA registration, environmental clearance (jahan applicable), aur fire/utility NOCs. Approvals ka status RERA page aur authority se verify karein.
Answer_EN: An under-construction project must possess: clear title, approved layout and building plan, Commencement Certificate (CC), RERA registration certificate, environmental clearance, and fire/utility NOCs. Verify all approvals directly on the state RERA portal.
Tags: builder issues, lawyer-verification, legal, possession delay, under-construction
Keywords: approvals, construction, have, project, registration, rera, under

Question_EN: Are pre-launch offers safe?
Question_Hinglish: Pre-launch offers safe hote hain?
Answer_Hinglish: Pre-launch me price kam hota hai par risk zyada, kyunki approvals ya RERA registration abhi complete na ho sakti hai. RERA registration hone se pehle booking amount dena avoid karein, aur project ka title aur approvals verify karke hi commit karein.
Answer_EN: Pre-launch offers carry discounted pricing but substantial risk, as necessary statutory approvals and RERA registration may not yet be in place. RERA strictly prohibits advertising or selling units prior to registration. Avoid advancing money before RERA registration is confirmed.
Tags: builder issues, possession delay, under-construction
Keywords: launch, offers, pre, registration, rera, rk, safe

Question_EN: Who handles maintenance right after possession and for how long?
Question_Hinglish: Possession ke baad maintenance kaun sambhalta hai?
Answer_Hinglish: Shuruaat me builder ya uski appointed agency maintenance sambhalti hai jab tak society/association formed nahi hoti. Maintenance charges, corpus fund aur handover process agreement me clearly likhe hote hain. Society formation ke baad ye responsibility residents ko transfer hoti hai.
Answer_EN: The developer or their appointed facility management agency handles maintenance until the registered society or resident association is formed and handed over. Maintenance charges and corpus fund allocations are governed by the sale agreement and transferred upon society formation.

Question_EN: How is parking allotted and is it charged separately?
Question_Hinglish: Parking allotment kaise hoti hai aur kya alag se charge lagta hai?
Answer_Hinglish: Parking allotment aur charges agreement me clearly likhe hone chahiye (covered/open/stilt). Kai projects me parking alag se charge hoti hai, isliye price sheet me parking ka status aur number/location likhwana zaroori hai. Rules state aur project ke hisab se alag ho sakte hain.
Answer_EN: Parking space allocation (covered, stilt, or open) must be clearly designated in the agreement. RERA mandates that open parking spaces cannot be sold separately as independent units. Ensure your parking slot number and demarcation are explicitly documented in your allotment paperwork.

Question_EN: Is GST applicable on under-construction property?
Question_Hinglish: Under-construction property par GST lagta hai?
Answer_Hinglish: Haan, under-construction properties par aam taur par GST lagta hai (affordable housing par kam rate), jabki OC milne ke baad ready property par GST nahi lagta. GST rates time-to-time badalte hain, isliye latest rate builder/CA se confirm karein.
Answer_EN: Under-construction properties attract 5% GST (or 1% for qualifying affordable housing units under ₹45 Lakh) without input tax credit. Once a property receives an Occupancy Certificate (OC) or for ready resale properties, zero GST is payable.

Question_EN: What is the risk of taking possession without OC?
Question_Hinglish: OC ke bina possession lene ka kya risk hai?
Answer_Hinglish: Bina OC ke ghar legally complete nahi maana jata, aur aapko utility connections, home loan, resale aur kabhi-kabhi legal action me problem aa sakti hai. Possession lene se pehle OC ki copy zaroor lein ya likhit me commitment aur timeline lein.
Answer_EN: Taking possession without an Occupancy Certificate (OC) is legally risky and exposes the property to eviction notices, higher municipal property tax penalties, utility disconnection, home loan rejection, and severe resale hurdles. Never occupy a home without a valid OC.
Tags: builder issues, lawyer-verification, legal, possession delay, under-construction
Keywords: possession, resale, risk, taking, without

Question_EN: Should I buy a flat in a redevelopment project?
Question_Hinglish: Redevelopment project me flat lena sahi hai?

Answer_EN: Flats in redevelopment projects can offer prime locations and discounted prices, but carry risks of society member litigation, developer insolvency, or approval delays. Scrutinize the Development Agreement, society consent percentage, financial guarantees, and RERA registration.
Tags: builder issues, possession delay, under-construction

Question_EN: How should I manage EMI if the project is delayed?
Question_Hinglish: Project delay ho to EMI kaise manage karein?
Answer_Hinglish: Bank ko delay ki jaankari dein aur disbursement status check karein. Aap builder se delay compensation maang sakte hain aur RERA me complaint kar sakte hain. Kiraye ke saath EMI ka budget alag rakhein, aur bank se restructuring ya tenure adjust options poochein.
Answer_EN: Notify your lender about project delays and monitor milestone disbursement statements. Demand statutory delay compensation from the developer under RERA, factor in parallel rent and pre-EMI expenses, and discuss loan restructuring or tenure extensions with your bank.
Tags: bank-advisory, builder issues, finance, possession delay, under-construction
Keywords: budget, delayed, emi, manage, project, rera, tenure

Question_EN: RERA authority or consumer court, where should I complain?
Question_Hinglish: RERA ya consumer court, kahan complaint karein?
Answer_Hinglish: Registered project me builder se related issue (delay, refund, defects) me RERA authority pehla aur zyada suitable option hota hai. Consumer court ka option bhi available hai, par ek hi issue par dono me alag se claim karne se pehle lawyer se salah lein.
Answer_EN: For RERA-registered projects involving construction delay, defects, or refund disputes, the state RERA Authority is the specialized and faster forum. Question_EN: Is GST applicable when buying property?

Answer_EN: GST applies solely to under-construction properties (5% for standard housing, 1% for affordable housing under ₹45 Lakh). Ready-to-move homes with an Occupancy Certificate (OC) and resale properties attract 0% GST. Agricultural land transactions are exempt from GST.

Question_EN: What is TDS on property purchase?
Question_Hinglish: Property kharidne par TDS kya hota hai?

Answer_EN: Under Section 194-IA of the Income Tax Act, if property consideration or circle rate exceeds ₹50 Lakh, the buyer must deduct 1% TDS from payments made to a resident seller and deposit it with the government using Form 26QB. The seller receives tax credit against their PAN.

Keywords: property, purchase, tds

Question_EN: How is capital gains tax calculated on selling property?
Question_Hinglish: Property bechne par capital gains tax kaise calculate hota hai?
Answer_Hinglish: Capital gain = sale price minus (purchase cost + improvement cost + transfer expenses). 24 mahine se zyada rakhne par long-term aur usse kam par short-term capital gain lagta hai. Rates aur indexation rules budget ke saath badalte hain, isliye CA se calculate karwayein.
Answer_EN: Capital gain = Sale consideration minus (Indexed cost of acquisition + Cost of improvements + Transfer expenses). Properties held for over 24 months are classified as long-term capital assets (LTCG); those held for 24 months or less attract short-term capital gains (STCG) taxed at individual income tax slabs.
Tags: ca-consultation, registration, stamp duty, tax, taxes
Keywords: budget, calculated, capital, capital gains, gains, property, selling, tax

Question_EN: What is the long-term capital gains tax rate on property?
Question_Hinglish: Property par long-term capital gains tax kitna hai?

Answer_EN: Following recent budget provisions, long-term capital gains on immovable property are generally taxed at a flat 12.5% without indexation benefit, while resident individuals acquiring properties prior to July 2024 have an optional 20% rate with indexation benefit. Verify your specific scenario with a CA.
Tags: ca-consultation, registration, stamp duty, tax, taxes
Keywords: capital, capital gains, gains, long, property, rate, tax, term

Question_EN: What is the Section 54 exemption on property sale?
Question_Hinglish: Section 54 exemption kya hai?

Answer_EN: Under Section 54, an individual or HUF selling a long-term residential house can claim tax exemption by reinvesting capital gains into another residential property within 1 year before or 2 years after sale (or 3 years for construction), subject to statutory caps and conditions.

Question_EN: What are 54EC bonds?
Question_Hinglish: 54EC bonds kya hote hain?

Answer_EN: Under Section 54EC, capital gains arising from the sale of long-term real estate can be exempted by investing up to ₹50 Lakh in specified capital gains bonds (such as NHAI, REC, or PFC) within 6 months of transfer. These bonds carry a mandatory 5-year lock-in period.

Question_EN: How is rental income taxed?
Question_Hinglish: Rental income par tax kaise lagta hai?

Answer_EN: Rental income is assessed under 'Income from House Property'. You can deduct municipal taxes actually paid, claim a flat 30% standard deduction towards repairs, and deduct eligible home loan interest under Section 24(b). Net rental income is taxed at your applicable income tax slab.

Question_EN: What is property tax and who pays it?

Question_EN: How is a second home taxed?

Question_EN: Is there tax on gifting property?

Question_EN: Is there inheritance tax on property in India?

Question_EN: How can I transfer property to spouse or children?

Question_EN: What tax applies when an NRI sells property in India?

Question_EN: Is agricultural land exempt from capital gains tax?

Question_EN: What is Section 50C and 56(2)(x) on property deals?
Question_Hinglish: Section 50C aur 56(2)(x) kya hain?
Answer_Hinglish: Agar property ka registered sale price stamp duty value/circle rate se kam ho (tolerance limit se zyada), to seller ko capital gains ki ganana stamp value par karni pad sakti hai (50C) aur buyer ko difference par income tax lag sakta hai (56(2)(x)). Isliye value ko circle rate ke kareeb rakhein aur CA se check karein.
Answer_EN: Section 50C mandates that if registered sale consideration is less than government stamp duty circle rate (beyond allowable tolerance limits of ~10%), circle rate is deemed the full value for calculating seller's capital gains. Section 56(2)(x) taxes the difference in the buyer's hands as other income.

Question_EN: Why are rent agreements usually for 11 months?

Question_EN: What is the notice period for vacating a rented house?

Question_EN: Can a landlord evict me without notice?

Question_EN: What is a lock-in period in a rent agreement?

Question_EN: Furnished, semi-furnished or unfurnished, which should I rent?
